habits.boundary_condition: when no nonstop flights available, consider one stop
habits.condition: user explicitly requests nonstop or no layovers
habits.exception_condition: user specifies a preferred airline with nonstop options
habits.name: flight_route_connection_policy
habits.rationale: users consistently prioritize nonstop flights unless forced to accept connections, with a clear preference for morning departures and economy class. multiple dialogues show users rejecting layovers and preferring direct routes, even when cheaper options exist with stops.

source_evidence.contribution: user explicitly requests nonstop and morning departure
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Just leave in the morning and no layovers non-stop.
I'd like to have a non-stop flight.

source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like a non-stop flight or if at the most one stop in coach.
